title: -(으)면 안 돼요
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide treats **-(으)면 안 되다** as a prohibition expression; it gives the politeness-level form **안 돼요** in classroom permission/prohibition contexts and contrasts a prohibited action with the permission construction **-어도 되다**. This entry is limited to that use.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 593–597 (printed pp. 581–585): form, prohibition, and response contrast with -어도 되다.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-아/어도 되다**, que expresa permiso, y con **-(으)ㄹ 수 없다**, que expresa imposibilidad. También contrasta con **-지 않아도 되다**, que indica ausencia de obligación.
